blurb: Satya Yoga offers a variety of yoga classes for all levels, private and semi-private sessions, a 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training program, and a 7-day mindfulness retreat in Goa, India. The retreat includes accommodations, meals, yoga classes, wellness activities, and cultural experiences. The studio is located in Tsawwassen and provides a welcoming community space with yoga props and a Karma yoga class supporting local charities.
